work.author: Augustine of Hippo
work.description: Augustine's short handbook of the faith for the layman Laurentius, in one book of thirty-three chapters and one hundred and twenty-two numbered sections. Section 32 states the distinction between the grace that goes before and the grace that follows. A locus is chapter.section or the section number alone.
work.title: Enchiridion ad Laurentium de fide spe et caritate
